Stone Pony (The), Asbury Park, NJ
Home » Statistical Information » Venues » Venues In New Jersey (NJ) » Stone Pony (The), Asbury Park, NJ

The Stone Pony, located in Asbury Park, New Jersey, is one of the world's best known music venues. It is known as a starting point for many musicians.
According to the vice president of the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, Robert Santelli, "The club has already earned its place in history as one of rock 'n' roll's great venues. Most rock critics and historians that I come in contact with on a regular basis feel that The Stone Pony is one of the greatest rock clubs of all time."

Source: Wikipedia | Homepage | See also: MusicBrainz

Springsteen did 99 performances, excl. rehearsals, at this venue.
